name: Agrippa II
title: The Last Herodian King
summary: Herod Agrippa II was the son of Agrippa I and the last king of the Herodian dynasty. Together with his sister Berenice, he heard Paul defend himself in Caesarea and uttered the famous words that it did not take much to persuade him to become a Christian.

keyEvents.title: Hearing Paul in Caesarea
keyEvents.description: Agrippa listened to Paul's defense before Festus and said that he was almost persuaded to become a Christian.
